description:
Welcome to Sanbre Skin (www.sanbreskin.com)! We are an up-and-coming skincare brand dedicated to creating high-performance, skin-loving formulas that deliver real, visible results. We believe that achieving healthy, glowing skin shouldn't be complicated, which is why our products focus on nourishing the skin barrier and enhancing your natural radiance.

As a growing startup, we know that the best recommendations come from authentic voices. We are looking for passionate beauty enthusiasts, skincare junkies, and content creators to join our community and grow alongside us!

Why Join the Sanbre Skin Affiliate Family?

We treat our affiliates like true partners. When you help us share the love for Sanbre Skin, we make sure you are generously rewarded.

  • Earn 12% Commission: You will receive a 12% cash commission on every single sale generated through your unique affiliate link.

  • Exclusive 10% Off for Your Community: Give your followers, friends, and family an incentive to buy with a custom 10% off coupon code unique to your brand.

  • Cookie Window: Generous tracking cookies to ensure you get credited for the sales you drive.

  • Early Access: Be the first to know about new product launches, promotions, and exclusive brand campaigns.

  • Supportive Partnership: We love amplifying our creators! Exceptional performers will have opportunities for gifted product, dedicated content features on our official pages, and increased commission tiers.

Who We Are Looking For:

  • Skincare bloggers, TikTokers, Instagram creators, and YouTubers who love sharing their daily routines, product reviews, and skin journeys.

  • Interactive-influencers who value authenticity and enjoy engaging with their community.

  • Anyone who is passionate about clean, effective skincare and helping others feel confident in their own skin.

How it Works:

  1. Apply: Click the join button and fill out your quick profile.

  2. Share: Use your unique link and 10% off code in your bio, Linktree, TikToks, Reels, or blog posts.

  3. Earn: Watch your commissions stack up in your UpPromote dashboard and get paid out directly!

Ready to help your audience achieve their ultimate skin goals? Apply today and join the Sanbre Skin crew!
payout_period: Payments to be processed 1st of each month (minimum payment value EUR 20).
